skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deal 3 consecutive hits of 40% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Add charge DMG equal to 600% of the target's max HP (capped by a percentage of Sonic's ATK), then deal 5 consecutive hits of 60% ATK DMG to a single back-row target. Continuously self-heal for 1 turn (up to 120% of the DMG dealt by this Ultimate).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Add charge DMG equal to 800% of the target's max HP (capped by a percentage of Sonic's ATK), then deal 5 consecutive hits of 80% ATK DMG to a single back-row target. Continuously self-heal for 1 turn (up to 150% of the DMG dealt by this Ultimate).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increase own max HP. At the start of battle, increase own SPD by 15%. During battle, grant same-row allies without [Tenacity] an extra [Tenacity] effect equal to 20% of their max HP, up to 2 times per ally.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increase own max HP. At the start of battle, increase own SPD by 15% and raise the SPD of same-row allies up to 90% of Sonic's SPD (if an ally's own SPD is already higher than the boosted value, their SPD is unchanged). During battle, grant same-row allies without [Tenacity] a [Tenacity] effect equal to 25% of their max HP, up to 2 times per ally.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increase own max HP. At the start of battle, increase own SPD% and raise the SPD of same-row allies up to 95% of Sonic's SPD (if an ally's own SPD is already higher than the boosted value, their SPD is unchanged). During battle, grant same-row allies without [Tenacity] a [Tenacity] effect equal to 30% of their max HP, up to 2 times per ally.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
